option.beyondTheGatesUnits.help: Adds the 20 Units of the expansion to the draw pile.
option.beyondTheGatesBuildings.help: Each Monarch has the Mine, the Tavern, the Temple and the Town, plus 3 Buildings drawn at random among the Barracks and those of the expansions played.
option.whatForgesLegends.help: Adds 26 Units, 18 Legendary Artifacts and 3 Buildings. The expansion is played as a whole.
